name: m41b_subsample
question: Is the alakazam width gain DATA HUNGER or lineage-specific? The ogerpon corpus (10,468 decisions) is under half the alakazam corpus (23,115) and the width columns read -1.99pp there against +2.78pp here. This trains the identical alakazam A/B on a corpus subsampled to 10,088 decisions -- within 4% of ogerpon's size. If the gain VANISHES, the 43 zero-init columns are simply data-hungry and the two results reconcile. If it SURVIVES at ogerpon's data volume, the effect is genuinely lineage-specific and the columns encode something alakazam uses and ogerpon does not.
